module Intro.Asset.Trade where

import Intro.Asset

template Trade
  with
    baseAssetCid : ContractId Asset
    baseAsset : Asset
    quoteApprovalCid : ContractId TransferApproval
    quoteAsset : Asset
  where
    signatory baseAsset.owner
    observer quoteAsset.owner

    choice Trade_Cancel
        : ()
        controller baseAsset.owner
        do
          return ()

    choice Trade_Reject
        : ()
        controller quoteAsset.owner
        do
          return ()

-- TRADE_SETTLE_BEGIN
    choice Trade_Settle
      : (ContractId Asset, ContractId Asset)
      with
        quoteAssetCid : ContractId Asset
        baseApprovalCid : ContractId TransferApproval
      controller quoteAsset.owner
      do
        fetchedBaseAsset <- fetch baseAssetCid
        assertMsg
          "Base asset mismatch"
          (baseAsset == fetchedBaseAsset with
            observers = baseAsset.observers)

        fetchedQuoteAsset <- fetch quoteAssetCid
        assertMsg
          "Quote asset mismatch"
          (quoteAsset == fetchedQuoteAsset with
            observers = quoteAsset.observers)

        transferredBaseCid <- exercise
          baseApprovalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with
            assetCid = baseAssetCid

        transferredQuoteCid <- exercise
          quoteApprovalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with
            assetCid = quoteAssetCid

        return (transferredBaseCid, transferredQuoteCid)
-- TRADE_SETTLE_END

-- Copyright (c) 2025 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
module Intro.AssetTests where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

import Intro.Asset.RoleTests

test_asset = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  tp <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob

  assetCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahb Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = tp

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

test_split = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, _, _), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = -30.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 0.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 101.0

  splitResult <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 30.0

  Some splitAsset <- queryContractId bank splitResult.splitAsset
  Some remainder <- queryContractId bank splitResult.remainder

  assert (splitAsset.quantity == 30.0)
  assert (remainder.quantity == 70.0)

  return (setupResult, splitResult)

test_merge = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, _, _), splitResult) <- test_split

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.splitAsset

  assetCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.remainder

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset.quantity == 100.0)

module Intro.Asset.RoleTests where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

setupRoles = do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  usdbank <- allocateParty "USD_Bank"

  ahia <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = alice

  ahib <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = bob

  aha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd ahia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  ahb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  return (alice, bob, usdbank, aha, ahb)

-- TEST_ISSUANCE_BEGIN
test_issuance = do
  setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb) <- setupRoles

  assetCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd aha Issue_Asset
      with
        symbol = "USD"
        quantity = 100.0

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

  return (setupResult, assetCid)
-- TEST_ISSUANCE_END

module Intro.AssetTests where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

import Intro.Asset.RoleTests

test_asset = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  tp <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob

  assetCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahb Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = tp

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

test_split = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, _, _), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = -30.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 0.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 101.0

  splitResult <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 30.0

  Some splitAsset <- queryContractId bank splitResult.splitAsset
  Some remainder <- queryContractId bank splitResult.remainder

  assert (splitAsset.quantity == 30.0)
  assert (remainder.quantity == 70.0)

  return (setupResult, splitResult)

test_merge = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, _, _), splitResult) <- test_split

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.splitAsset

  assetCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.remainder

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset.quantity == 100.0)

module Intro.Asset.RoleTests where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  usdbank <- allocateParty "USD_Bank"

  ahia <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = alice

  ahib <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank

module Intro.Asset.MultiTradeTests where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.MultiTrade
import Intro.Asset.Role

import Intro.Asset.TradeSetup

-- Define this type to be able pass in JSON.
-- RELATIONSHIP_BEGIN
data Relationship = Relationship with
  issuer : Party
  owner : Party
    deriving (Eq, Show)
-- RELATIONSHIP_END

setupRelationship : Relationship -> Script (ContractId AssetHolder) 
setupRelationship (Relationship with issuer; owner)  = script do
  ahi <- submit issuer do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = issuer
      owner = owner

  submit owner do
  exerciseCmd ahi AssetHolderInvite_Accept

-- ISSUE_ASSET_BEGIN
issueAsset : Asset -> Script (ContractId Asset)
issueAsset asset@(Asset with ..) = do
  assetHolders <- queryFilter @AssetHolder issuer
    (\ah -> (ah.issuer == issuer) && (ah.owner == owner))

  case assetHolders of
    (ahCid, _)::_ -> submit asset.issuer do
      exerciseCmd ahCid Issue_Asset with ..
    [] -> abort ("No AssetHolder found for " <> show asset)
-- ISSUE_ASSET_END

testMultiTrade = script do
  -- Use the V1 Trade Setup Script to set up parties and issue assets:
  -- TUPLE_USE_BEGIN
  (alice, bob, usdbank, eurbank, usdha, usdhb, eurha, eurhb, usdCid, eurCid) <- tradeSetup
  -- TUPLE_USE_END

  -- Introduce two more banks:
  chfbank <- allocateParty "CHF_Bank"
  gbpbank <- allocateParty "GBP_Bank"

  -- Set up relationships
  -- MAPA_BEGIN
  let rels = 
        [ Relationship chfbank alice
        , Relationship chfbank bob
        , Relationship gbpbank alice
        , Relationship gbpbank bob
        ]
  [chfha, chfhb, gbpha, gbphb] <- mapA setupRelationship rels
  -- MAPA_END

  let chf = Asset with
        issuer = chfbank
        owner = alice
        symbol = "CHF"
        quantity = 120.0
        observers = []
  chfCid <- issueAsset chf
  
  let gbp = Asset with
        issuer = gbpbank
        owner = bob
        symbol = "GBP"
        quantity = 100.0
        observers = []
  gbpCid <- issueAsset gbp

  -- Alice wants to swap her 100 USD + 120 CHF for Bob's 90 EUR + 100 GBP

  -- First, she has to show her assets to bob and get pre-approval for the transfer of EUR and GBP
  let
    eur = Asset with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "EUR"
      quantity = 90.0
      observers = []

  -- FORA_EXAMPLE_BEGIN
  [usdCid, chfCid] <- forA [usdCid, chfCid] (\cid -> submit alice do
    exerciseCmd cid SetObservers with
      newObservers = [bob]
    )
  -- FORA_EXAMPLE_END
  
  eurtaCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurha Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = eur
  gbptaCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd gbpha Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = gbp
  
  -- Now she can createCmd the trade
  Some usd <- queryContractId alice usdCid
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = [usdCid, chfCid]
      baseAssets = [usd, chf]
      quoteApprovalCids = [eurtaCid, gbptaCid]
      quoteAssets = [eur, gbp]

  -- Bob accepts by supplying transfer approvals and assets.
  Some usd <- queryContractId bob usdCid
  usdtaCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd usdhb Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = usd
  chftaCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd chfhb Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = chf
  ([usdCid, chfCid], [eurCid, gbpCid]) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = [eurCid, gbpCid]
      baseApprovalCids = [usdtaCid, chftaCid]

  Some eur <- queryContractId eurbank eurCid
  assert (eur.owner == alice)

  Some gbp <- queryContractId gbpbank gbpCid
  assert (gbp.owner == alice)

  Some usd <- queryContractId usdbank usdCid
  assert (usd.owner == bob)

  Some chf <- queryContractId chfbank chfCid
  assert (chf.owner == bob)

  return ()

-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module Intro.Asset.TradeSetup where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

setupRoles = do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  usdbank <- allocateParty "USD_Bank"

  ahia <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = alice

  ahib <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = bob

  aha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd ahia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  ahb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  return (alice, bob, usdbank, aha, ahb)

test_issuance = do
  setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb) <- setupRoles

  assetCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd aha Issue_Asset
      with
        symbol = "USD"
        quantity = 100.0

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

  return (setupResult, assetCid)

-- A copy of the `tradeSetup` Script from the chapter 7 model
tradeSetup = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, usdbank, usdha, usdhb), usdCid) <- test_issuance
  eurbank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"

  eurhia <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = alice

  eurhib <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = bob

  eurha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurhia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurhb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd eurhib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurCid <- submit eurbank do
    exerciseCmd eurhb Issue_Asset with
      symbol = "EUR"
      quantity = 90.0

-- TUPLE_RETURN_BEGIN
  return (alice, bob, usdbank, eurbank, usdha, usdhb, eurha, eurhb, usdCid, eurCid)
-- TUPLE_RETURN_END

      asset = eur
  gbptaCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd gbpha Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = gbp
  
  -- Now she can createCmd the trade
  Some usd <- queryContractId alice usdCid
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = [usdCid, chfCid]
      baseAssets = [usd, chf]
      quoteApprovalCids = [eurtaCid, gbptaCid]
      quoteAssets = [eur, gbp]

  -- Bob accepts by supplying transfer approvals and assets.
  Some usd <- queryContractId bob usdCid
  usdtaCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd usdhb Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = usd
  chftaCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd chfhb Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = chf
  ([usdCid, chfCid], [eurCid, gbpCid]) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = [eurCid, gbpCid]
      baseApprovalCids = [usdtaCid, chftaCid]

  Some eur <- queryContractId eurbank eurCid
  assert (eur.owner == alice)

  Some gbp <- queryContractId gbpbank gbpCid
  assert (gbp.owner == alice)

  Some usd <- queryContractId usdbank usdCid
  assert (usd.owner == bob)

  Some chf <- queryContractId chfbank chfCid
  assert (chf.owner == bob)

  return ()

module Intro.Asset.TradeSetup where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

setupRoles = do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  usdbank <- allocateParty "USD_Bank"

  ahia <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = alice

  ahib <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = bob

  aha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd ahia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  ahb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  return (alice, bob, usdbank, aha, ahb)

test_issuance = do
  setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb) <- setupRoles

  assetCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd aha Issue_Asset
      with
        symbol = "USD"
        quantity = 100.0

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

  return (setupResult, assetCid)

-- A copy of the `tradeSetup` Script from the chapter 7 model
tradeSetup = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, usdbank, usdha, usdhb), usdCid) <- test_issuance
  eurbank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"

  eurhia <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = alice

  eurhib <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = bob

  eurha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurhia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurhb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd eurhib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurCid <- submit eurbank do
    exerciseCmd eurhb Issue_Asset with
      symbol = "EUR"
      quantity = 90.0

-- TUPLE_RETURN_BEGIN
  return (alice, bob, usdbank, eurbank, usdha, usdhb, eurha, eurhb, usdCid, eurCid)
-- TUPLE_RETURN_END

module Intro.Asset.TradeTests where

import Daml.Script
import DA.Foldable (mapA_)

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role
import Intro.Asset.RoleTests (test_issuance)
import Intro.Asset.Trade

setup = do
  ((alice, bob, usdBank, _, usdBobHolder), originalBaseCid) <- test_issuance
  eurBank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"
  aliceInvite <- submit eurBank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = alice
  bobInvite <- submit eurBank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = bob
  eurAliceHolder <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd aliceInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
  eurBobHolder <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd bobInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
  originalQuoteCid <- submit eurBank do
    exerciseCmd eurBobHolder Issue_Asset with symbol = "EUR"; quantity = 90.0

  baseCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd originalBaseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob]
  quoteCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd originalQuoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice]
  Some base <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some quote <- queryContractId alice quoteCid
  quoteApprovalCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurAliceHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = quote
  baseApprovalCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd usdBobHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = base
  pure (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid)

makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote = submit alice do
  createCmd Trade with
    baseAssetCid = baseCid
    baseAsset = base
    quoteApprovalCid = quoteApprovalCid
    quoteAsset = quote

test_trade_settles_both_assets = script do
  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid

  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid

  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])
  assert (receivedBaseCid /= baseCid)
  assert (receivedQuoteCid /= quoteCid)
  archivedTrade <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
  archivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank baseCid
  archivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank quoteCid
  archivedBaseApproval <- queryContractId usdBank baseApprovalCid
  archivedQuoteApproval <- queryContractId eurBank quoteApprovalCid
  assert (archivedTrade == None)
  assert (archivedBase == None)
  assert (archivedQuote == None)
  assert (archivedBaseApproval == None)
  assert (archivedQuoteApproval == None)

test_trade_allows_observer_changes = script do
  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid (base with observers = []) quoteApprovalCid (quote with observers = [])
  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice, usdBank]
  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do

      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])

index e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391..470e00c540022b6eb346eab0e7eab9025cf775d0
--- a/sdk/docs/source/sdk/tutorials/smart-contracts/daml/daml-intro-test/asset-tests/daml/Intro/Asset/TradeTests.daml
+++ b/sdk/docs/source/sdk/tutorials/smart-contracts/daml/daml-intro-test/asset-tests/daml/Intro/Asset/TradeTests.daml
@@ -0,0 +1,218 @@
+module Intro.Asset.TradeTests where
+
+import Daml.Script
+import DA.Foldable (mapA_)
+
+import Intro.Asset
+import Intro.Asset.Role
+import Intro.Asset.RoleTests (test_issuance)
+import Intro.Asset.Trade
+
+setup = do
+  ((alice, bob, usdBank, _, usdBobHolder), originalBaseCid) <- test_issuance
+  eurBank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"
+  aliceInvite <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = alice
+  bobInvite <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = bob
+  eurAliceHolder <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd aliceInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
+  eurBobHolder <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd bobInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
+  originalQuoteCid <- submit eurBank do
+    exerciseCmd eurBobHolder Issue_Asset with symbol = "EUR"; quantity = 90.0
+
+  baseCid <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd originalBaseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob]
+  quoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd originalQuoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice]
+  Some base <- queryContractId alice baseCid
+  Some quote <- queryContractId alice quoteCid
+  quoteApprovalCid <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd eurAliceHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = quote
+  baseApprovalCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd usdBobHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = base
+  pure (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid)
+
+makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote = submit alice do
+  createCmd Trade with
+    baseAssetCid = baseCid
+    baseAsset = base
+    quoteApprovalCid = quoteApprovalCid
+    quoteAsset = quote
+
+test_trade_settles_both_assets = script do
+  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+
+  submitMustFail alice do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
+  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
+  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedBaseCid /= baseCid)
+  assert (receivedQuoteCid /= quoteCid)
+  archivedTrade <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
+  archivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank baseCid
+  archivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank quoteCid
+  archivedBaseApproval <- queryContractId usdBank baseApprovalCid
+  archivedQuoteApproval <- queryContractId eurBank quoteApprovalCid
+  assert (archivedTrade == None)
+  assert (archivedBase == None)
+  assert (archivedQuote == None)
+  assert (archivedBaseApproval == None)
+  assert (archivedQuoteApproval == None)
+
+test_trade_allows_observer_changes = script do
+  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid (base with observers = []) quoteApprovalCid (quote with observers = [])
+  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice, usdBank]
+  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
+  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
+  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])
+
+test_trade_cancel_and_reject = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, _, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  canceledTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Cancel
+  submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Cancel
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  rejectedTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail alice do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Reject
+  submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Reject
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  finalTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd finalTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_mismatched_assets = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, _, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  anotherBank <- allocateParty "Another_Bank"
+  let badBases =
+        [ base with quantity = 101.0
+        , base with symbol = "GBP"
+        , base with issuer = anotherBank
+        ]
+  mapA_ (\badBase -> do
+    tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid badBase quoteApprovalCid quote
+    submitMustFail bob do
+      exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+        quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+        baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+    ) badBases
+  let badQuotes =
+        [ quote with quantity = 91.0
+        , quote with symbol = "CHF"
+        , quote with issuer = anotherBank
+        ]
+  mapA_ (\badQuote -> do
+    tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid badQuote
+    submitMustFail bob do
+      exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+        quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+        baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+    ) badQuotes
+  goodTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd goodTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = baseCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd goodTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_stale_quote_and_consumed_approval = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice, eurBank]
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  Some changedQuote <- queryContractId bob changedQuoteCid
+  replacementTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid changedQuote
+  submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd quoteApprovalCid TransferApproval_Reject
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd replacementTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  newQuoteApproval <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = changedQuote; newOwner = alice
+  workingTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base newQuoteApproval changedQuote
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd workingTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_wrong_approvals_and_stale_assets = script do

+module Intro.Asset.TradeTests where
+
+import Daml.Script
+import DA.Foldable (mapA_)
+
+import Intro.Asset
+import Intro.Asset.Role
+import Intro.Asset.RoleTests (test_issuance)
+import Intro.Asset.Trade
+
+setup = do
+  ((alice, bob, usdBank, _, usdBobHolder), originalBaseCid) <- test_issuance
+  eurBank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"
+  aliceInvite <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = alice
+  bobInvite <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with issuer = eurBank; owner = bob
+  eurAliceHolder <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd aliceInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
+  eurBobHolder <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd bobInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
+  originalQuoteCid <- submit eurBank do
+    exerciseCmd eurBobHolder Issue_Asset with symbol = "EUR"; quantity = 90.0
+
+  baseCid <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd originalBaseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob]
+  quoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd originalQuoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice]
+  Some base <- queryContractId alice baseCid
+  Some quote <- queryContractId alice quoteCid
+  quoteApprovalCid <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd eurAliceHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = quote
+  baseApprovalCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd usdBobHolder Preapprove_Transfer with asset = base
+  pure (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid)
+
+makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote = submit alice do
+  createCmd Trade with
+    baseAssetCid = baseCid
+    baseAsset = base
+    quoteApprovalCid = quoteApprovalCid
+    quoteAsset = quote
+
+test_trade_settles_both_assets = script do
+  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+
+  submitMustFail alice do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
+  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
+  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedBaseCid /= baseCid)
+  assert (receivedQuoteCid /= quoteCid)
+  archivedTrade <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
+  archivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank baseCid
+  archivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank quoteCid
+  archivedBaseApproval <- queryContractId usdBank baseApprovalCid
+  archivedQuoteApproval <- queryContractId eurBank quoteApprovalCid
+  assert (archivedTrade == None)
+  assert (archivedBase == None)
+  assert (archivedQuote == None)
+  assert (archivedBaseApproval == None)
+  assert (archivedQuoteApproval == None)
+
+test_trade_allows_observer_changes = script do
+  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid (base with observers = []) quoteApprovalCid (quote with observers = [])
+  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice, usdBank]
+  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId usdBank receivedBaseCid
+  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId eurBank receivedQuoteCid
+  assert (receivedBase == base with owner = bob; observers = [])
+  assert (receivedQuote == quote with owner = alice; observers = [])
+
+test_trade_cancel_and_reject = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, _, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  canceledTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Cancel
+  submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Cancel
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd canceledTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  rejectedTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail alice do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Reject
+  submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Reject
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd rejectedTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  finalTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd finalTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_mismatched_assets = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, _, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  anotherBank <- allocateParty "Another_Bank"
+  let badBases =
+        [ base with quantity = 101.0
+        , base with symbol = "GBP"
+        , base with issuer = anotherBank
+        ]
+  mapA_ (\badBase -> do
+    tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid badBase quoteApprovalCid quote
+    submitMustFail bob do
+      exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+        quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+        baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+    ) badBases
+  let badQuotes =
+        [ quote with quantity = 91.0
+        , quote with symbol = "CHF"
+        , quote with issuer = anotherBank
+        ]
+  mapA_ (\badQuote -> do
+    tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid badQuote
+    submitMustFail bob do
+      exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+        quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+        baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+    ) badQuotes
+  goodTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd goodTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = baseCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd goodTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_stale_quote_and_consumed_approval = script do
+  (alice, bob, _, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [alice, eurBank]
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  Some changedQuote <- queryContractId bob changedQuoteCid
+  replacementTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid changedQuote
+  submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd quoteApprovalCid TransferApproval_Reject
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd replacementTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  newQuoteApproval <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = changedQuote; newOwner = alice
+  workingTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base newQuoteApproval changedQuote
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd workingTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
+
+test_trade_rejects_wrong_approvals_and_stale_assets = script do
+  (alice, bob, usdBank, eurBank, baseCid, base, quoteCid, quote, baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid) <- setup
+  tradeCid <- makeTrade alice baseCid base quoteApprovalCid quote
+  badBaseApproval <- submit usdBank do
+    createCmd TransferApproval with
+      asset = base with quantity = 1.0
+      newOwner = bob
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = badBaseApproval
+
+  badQuoteApproval <- submit eurBank do
+    createCmd TransferApproval with
+      asset = quote with quantity = 1.0
+      newOwner = alice
+  badQuoteTrade <- makeTrade alice baseCid base badQuoteApproval quote
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd badQuoteTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+
+  staleBaseCid <- submit alice do
+    exerciseCmd baseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob, eurBank]
+  submitMustFail bob do
+    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  Some currentBase <- queryContractId alice staleBaseCid
+  workingTrade <- makeTrade alice staleBaseCid currentBase quoteApprovalCid quote
+  _ <- submit bob do
+    exerciseCmd workingTrade Trade_Settle with
+      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
+      baseApprovalCid = baseApprovalCid
+  pure ()
